Date June 6, 1935.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
File No. 6725
No. D

Subject Judgment against Ri Toku Sei(李德成), alias Ri Sei Yuh(李世雄),
Korean.
Made by D. S. Kamashite Forwarded by [签名] 89

In continuation of the attached report on the
subject of the arrest of Ri Toku Sei(李德成), I Have to
report that this individual has been detained at the local
Japanese Consulate-General since his arrest on March 29th,
1935. As the result of investigation made by the 2nd
Branch( Special Branch) of the Consular Police it was
revealed that this person had no connection with any
communistic or other political offence. Accordingly he
was handed over to the Crime Branch of the Consular Police
and charged with larceny, fraud and misappropriation in
accordance with the charge made by Hongkew Station, S.M.P..
On June 5th, 1935, Ri Toku Sei was sentenced at the
Japanese Consular Court to 6 months imprisonment and he will
be sent to Nagasaki Gaol in the near future for execution
of the judgment.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

报告
日期：1935年6月6日。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科档案室
档案编号 6725
D 号

事由：对朝鲜人 Ri Toku Sei（李德成），别名 Ri Sei Yuh（李世雄）的判决。
由 D. S. Kamashite 呈报 [签名] 89

继所附关于逮捕 Ri Toku Sei（李德成）的报告之后，本人须报告称，该人自1935年3月29日被捕以来，一直被拘留于当地日本总领事馆。经领事警察第二科（特务科）调查，查明此人与任何共产主义或其他政治罪行均无关联。因此，他被移交给领事警察刑事科，并根据上海公共租界工部局警务处虹口巡捕房提出的指控，以盗窃、诈骗和侵占罪被起诉。1935年6月5日，Ri Toku Sei 在日本领事法院被判处六个月监禁，不久将被送往长崎监狱执行判决。

D. Kamashita
D. S.

特务科副督察长。

抄送：刑事科
供参考。

S. 2. Special Branch/Station,
REPORT
Date April 2, 1935.

Subject (in full) Arrest of Ri Toku Sei(李德成), Korean Radical suspect.

Made by J.D.S. Kamashite Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

A Korean named Ri Toku Sei(李德成), age 22, was
arrested by J.D.S. 131 Iguchi attached to Hongkew Station
at Chenoo and Soochow Roads corner on a charge of larceny
at 11.00 a.m., March 29 and immediately handed over to the
Japanese Consular Police. In the course of enquiries at
the Consulate it was revealed that this individual was wanted
by the Consular Police as a radical suspect.
Information regarding his record will be forwarded
after the completion of enquiries by the Japanese Authorities.

J. Kamashita
J.D.C.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

S2,
Further report please in
due course.
**〔此处转录不清〕**
8 APR 1935
Jl. Kamashita
3/4/35.

报告
日期：1935年4月2日。

事由（全称）：逮捕朝鲜激进嫌疑分子 Ri Toku Sei（李德成）。

由 J.D.S. Kamashite 呈报 转发者 **〔此处转录不清〕**

一名名叫 Ri Toku Sei（李德成）的朝鲜人，22岁，于3月29日上午11时，在常州路与苏州路转角处，因涉嫌盗窃罪，被隶属于虹口巡捕房的 J.D.S. 131号警员 Iguchi 逮捕，并立即移交给日本领事警察。在领事馆进行问询期间，查明此人因系激进嫌疑分子而被领事警察通缉。
待日本当局完成问询后，将报送有关其履历的情报。

J. Kamashita
J.D.C.

特务科副督察长。

S2，
请适时提交进一步报告。
**〔此处转录不清〕**
1935年4月8日
Jl. Kamashita
1935年4月3日。
